A woman attacked a young Ukrainian man on a nearly empty Warsaw tram, according to local media outlets.

Vitaly Lyalikov, 23, was heading home from MMA training around 10:30 p.m. and had put his backpack on the seat next to him. A woman got on, started a row over the backpack and threw his things on the floor. He didn't react. A few minutes later she came back and hit him on the head.

Lyalikov says he trains MMA professionally, so he chose not to fight back and filmed her instead. He says he hadn't spoken to anyone, but he was wearing a jacket with Ukraine's coat of arms. Whether that was the reason for the attack is unclear. They got off at the same stop and she simply walked away.

The incident comes a day after a 22-year-old Ukrainian set himself on fire in central Warsaw, reportedly in protest against discrimination against Ukrainians in Poland.
